_schema.id: unique id (q### hand-written, xq### generated from XBRL)
_schema.question: natural-language question
_schema.category: reported_fact | calculation | management_explanation | cross_period | risk | forward_looking | insufficient_evidence
_schema.should_abstain: true if the available filings cannot answer it (correct behaviour = decline)
_schema.gold_answer: reference answer text (used by the LLM judge for non-numeric questions)
_schema.gold_numeric: {value, unit: usd_millions|percent|usd|count, tolerance_rel, tolerance_abs} or null
_schema.gold_evidence_snippets: SHORT verbatim phrases copied from the filing text; retrieval is graded on these
_schema.acceptable_sources: [{filing_type, fiscal_year, fiscal_period?}] filings that may supply the evidence (empty = any)
_schema.verified: true once a person checked the answer + evidence against the filing
